notes: Day 25 continues: the commemoration of Abba Eblo'i of Akmim ends here (¶፳፱ Yewahit, ¶፴ repose on 5 Yekatit, ¶፴፩ doxology); a new commemoration (St Yolyos/Julius of Akfahs, "ወበዛቲ ዕለት ካዕበ" / "በዚችም ቀን ዳግመኛ") starts at ¶፴፪ - same Day 25, no day opener. First lines are a new paragraph (p102 ended on a complete ¶፳፰, so nothing to join). Numerals ፳፱ ፴ ፴፩ ፴፪ ፴፫ ፴፬ ፴፭ are small/dotted/garbled and inferred from the running sequence. Doxology reads ይምሐረን.
